mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, bucket, object_key, size_bytes, sha256
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_payload_blobs (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, bucket, object_key, size_bytes, sha256) VALUES (#{blob.UUID}, #{blob.ExternalID}, #{blob.OrganizationUUID}, #{blob.WorkspaceUUID}, #{blob.Bucket}, #{blob.Key}, #{blob.Size}, #{blob.SHA256,sensitive=true})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM event_payload_blobs WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{blobUUID} AND state = 'attached'
mapper.update: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT b.uuid FROM event_payload_blobs b WHERE b.state IN ('pending', 'attached') AND b.updated_at < now() - interval '24 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid AND e.payload_blob_uuid = b.uuid AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_session_internal_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = b.workspace_uuid AND e.payload_blob_uuid = b.uuid AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY b.updated_at, b.uuid LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF b SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE event_payload_blobs SET state = 'deleting', updated_at = now() WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM candidates) RETURNING
